author: edwong57
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete the following terms:
GO:1904154 positive regulation of retrograde protein transport, ER to cytosol
GO:1904153 negative regulation of retrograde protein transport, ER to cytosol
GO:1904152 regulation of retrograde protein transport, ER to cytosol

see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/32525

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1VLa_M9UXc3QzuURV3-yfovbu57239bVA3k4-hE0dTi8/edit?usp=sharing

Impacted groups: 
SGD 1
ParkinsonsUK-UCL 18 - done

** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv
----

No mappings that need to be reviewed.


Thanks.
